snippet.title: CatCraft: Prototype Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Step into CatCraft, a cozy first-person farming and alchemy sim where you craft magical cats in your own cat café. This is our first prototype gameplay showcase—plant, gather ingredients, and create endless unique cats to brighten a gray city.

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3942220/Cat_Craft/
